Subject: Revised delegation of Financial Powers.
Sir,

You may be aware that in exercise or powers conferred under section 5E of the EPF &
MP Act, 1952, Central Board of Trustees, EPF in its 200" meeting held on 07.08.2012 has
reviewed the existing Financial Powers delegated to the Executive Committee and Central
Provident Fund Commissioner.

2. The Chairman, CBT has been delegated Administrative and Financial powers to sanction
expenditure for “matters related to Information Technology and E-governance initiatives
including appointment of consultants” in the offices of the Employees’ Provident Fund
Organization to the extent considered necessary, irrespective of any monetary limit. The Board
further approved the proposals above Rs. 25 Crores would be first placed for consideration of
Executive Committee and thereafter to Chairman, CBT, EPF along with views/comments of
Executive Committee.

3: Executive Committee, CBT, EPF in addition to the functions already delegated has been
delegated administrative and financial powers to sanction expenditure for “matters related to
Information Technology and E-governance initiatives including appointment of consultants” in
the offices of the Employees’ Provident Fund Organization to the extent of Rs. 25 Crores
(Rupees Twenty Five Crores only).

4. Central PF Commissioner has been delegated Administrative and Financial powers to
sanction expenditure for “matters related to information technology and E-governance
initiatives including appointment of consultants” in the offices of the Employees’ Provident
Fund Organization to the extent of Rs. 5 Crores (Rupees Five Crores only).
